title: From spectral counts to two recovered material fields
description: CT-ORG case 2 supplies assigned water/bone anatomy in a declared matched 16³ trilinear basis. Both independent prescribed noise replicates are retained.

images.alt: Both prescribed final reconstructions reduce the fitting objective and reach the unchanged Euclidean stationarity threshold.

Fixed physical zero-plane fields for replicate 0: assigned water and bone, uniform start, available update-100 checkpoint, stationary recovery and signed error. Coarse matched-model assigned fractions, not patient composition.

Fixed physical zero-plane fields for replicate 1: assigned water and bone, uniform start, available update-100 checkpoint, stationary recovery and signed error. Coarse matched-model assigned fractions, not patient composition.

reading: The starting field is uniform water. Only the 48 fitting views enter either solve. Both fields and their stopping diagnostics are fixed before the evaluator opens assigned references and 12 disjoint withheld views. The mapping tests constrained stationarity; material and withheld errors test recovery under the declared matched model. All must pass.
